title: Distance betwen SMS boluses not applied
symptom: Remote SMS bolus attempts failed with error messages, and the boluses were not shown in the app graph until the app was restarted, after which they appeared as delivered. The pump communication was broken and did not reconnect, but the pump was not reported as unavailable.
cause: Bad communication with pump, possibly due to distance between pump and phone. The phone initiated a connection and started the bolus, then the connection broke, causing AAPS to report unsuccessful bolus.
fix: No solution; the error message was improved in a commit. The issue was resolved by restarting the app, which then showed all boluses as delivered.
evidence_quote: The primary reason is bad communication with pump maybe because of distance between pump and phone. In this case phone was able to to initiate a connection to the pump and start bolus. Then connection was broken and AAPS has to report unsuccessful bolus.
